guide.automagy.maw.crafting: Place obsidian directly above a hungry chest. Use a wand fitted with the portable hole focus on that obsidian after completing this research. The chest is consumed. The process checks above, north, south, west and east, consuming up to four obsidian blocks and producing one maw per block. Keep the area loaded until it finishes.
guide.automagy.maw.filter: Use a populated runic filter on the finical maw to insert it. Use an empty hand to retrieve the filter. Configure the paper before inserting it. Whitelist quantities limit the destination inventory; blacklist quantities leave that many items in the dropped stack.

guide.automagy.requisition.delivery: Requests are delivered by linked Fill golems to their home inventory, using the home's configured side. The Requisition Tome is a request terminal, not an item container. Bind a golem to a suitable receiving container with the golem bell, then use the Automagy linker to connect that golem to the taskmaster. The taskmaster must be connected to the Inventarium and have memory capacity. Mirror-based routing is a separate system. Multi-Destination Mirrors now route requested items to each tome's selected output mirror; see Melding Mirrors for eye configuration.
guide.automagy.inventarium.structure: Place the core above an Order Crystal Cluster, with amber two blocks below the core. On the cluster's level, arrange eight bookshelves at offsets (±2,±1) and (±1,±2). Keep the eight neighboring blocks around both core and cluster empty. Placing the core consumes the cluster. Nearby shelves each permit reading 81 slots. Order clusters within three blocks add one connection and eight blocks of range. The base limit is one connection at a distance of ten.
guide.automagy.inventarium.view: Use a wand on an Unseen Scribe to connect it to the nearest available core. Supply Order vis from above. Without a pointer, its facing selects the first container within three blocks; the scribe records that container type in a cube of radius three. Right-click without a wand to view recorded contents. Sorting and page controls only change the view; displayed items cannot be taken. An asterisk means shelf capacity omitted some slots.
gui.automagy.hand_mirror.help: Filters control pickup. The center slot sends manually.
guide.automagy.locus.structure: Build a 3x3 pool of source water with a lapis block at its center, edged by twelve silverwood planks (no corners). Put a water crystal cluster on the lapis and place the locus above it. Keep the eight surrounding spaces clear on both levels above the pool. The cluster is consumed; breaking the locus returns six water shards. Insert linked crystal eyes to discover connected containers. Empty-hand use retrieves the last eye. Water crystals touching the rim increase the limits.

automagy.page.thaumostatic_structure:
Build one vertical column: chiseled quartz at the bottom, one controller and at least two pylons, then a thaumium block exposed to the sky with an empty block above it. The controller may sit anywhere between the quartz and the cap. Up to six pylons improve performance.
Tap a horizontal controller face with a wand: 50 Aer, 20 Ignis, 20 Ordo, 10 Aqua. The cap becomes a two-block spire. Supply Aer centivis to the spire or controller and Potentia essentia through side pipes. Wand-tap each side to cycle Potentia, Aer and Volatus suction. Aer increases range; Volatus increases transfer speed. Each booster lasts 1200 powered ticks.
automagy.page.nethermind_structure:
Structure (N = Nethermind, R = rune, . = air):
...R...
...R...
..RRR..
RRRNRRR
..RRR..
...R...
...R...
Add one rune immediately below the end of each of the four arms. There are 20 runes in total. Keep the space underneath clear. Start with a wand holding 75 Ignis and 25 Ordo; supply Ignis centivis through a relay above the controller.
automagy.page.dimension_lure_structure:
Place the lure directly 6–10 blocks below the Nethermind (8–10 for ghasts). Keep a 5 by 5 shaft clear between them. At the lure's level, build this ring of BASIC runed obsidian (L = lure):
..RRR..
.R...R.
R.....R
R..L..R
R.....R
.R...R.
..RRR..
Activate the lure before the Nethermind. Do not mix block and creature runes; use at least four creature runes.
tc.research_page.automagy:NETHERMIND.4: Rock runes increase the chance of netherrack. Four output runes exclude basic random output; more copies increase that output's weight. Cost per netherrack: Ignis 1, Terra 2 (basic runes: Ignis 2, Terra 4).
tc.research_page.automagy:NETHERMIND.5: Sea runes conjure lava. Cost per conjuration: Ignis 6, Terra 2. Four output runes exclude basic random output.

guide.automagy.mirrors: Bind a Crystal Eye to a paired Thaumcraft mirror, then insert it into a Melding Mirror to send incoming items to that selected mirror's output queue. Shift-use a wand to remove the eye. To bind an eye to a Melding Mirror itself, sneak while using the eye. Link a Multi-Destination Mirror to an Inventarium with a wand; it forwards only requested items to the requesting tome's output mirror. On a Requisition Tome, insert a bound eye normally for input, or while sneaking for output. Both selected mirrors must be within 5 blocks. Use the tome with an item to deposit through the input mirror; empty-hand opens requests. Shift-use a wand to remove both eyes. Endpoints must be loaded; unaccepted items stay with the sender.
guide.automagy.focus.open: Attach the Crafting focus to a wand and use it to open a portable 3x3 workbench. Opening costs 7 Ordo vis. Arcane recipes cost their normal vis plus another 7 Ordo; ordinary recipes have no extra charge. Gratis removes the opening and additional costs. Storage keeps unused ingredients in the focus. C opens the focus; Transposing also finds it in your inventory or focus pouch and exchanges the attached focus. Staffs support ordinary recipes only.
jei.automagy.focus_fee: Base vis cost; the crafting focus also charges 7 Ordo unless upgraded with Gratis. Wand discounts apply.

tc.research_page.automagy:ENTROPICREFINI: Dissolve infused stone in a crucible with three Perditio and one Vitreus to recover slivers of its primal aspect. The recipe display shows the yield configured for this world.
tc.research_page.automagy:ADVNODEJAR.1: Build a hollow 3 by 3 by 3 shell of warded glass around an aura node. Cover it with a 3 by 3 layer of warded silverwood logs. You must own all nine warded logs and all 26 warded glass blocks.
tc.research_page.automagy:ADVNODEJAR.2: Use a casting wand without an attached focus on the shell. The operation costs 125 of each primal vis before discounts and consumes the shell. The captured node retains its type, brightness, identity and available aspects. A denied or failed conversion leaves the structure intact.
